notes: The heading at the top of a booking confirmation no longer forces a venue into the title. One job at one venue still reads Event @ Venue. A run of dates at one venue keeps it too; different rooms, or rooms nobody has booked yet, drop it from the title and the line underneath carries the detail - 3 events, the date range, and either the venues or venues to be confirmed. Crew, delivery, prep and change emails follow the same rule.
